Definition: prolongation for G4986; Sosipatrus, a Christian:--Sosipater.
BiblicalUsage: Sosipater is named once, in Paul's greetings from Corinth: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you. Paul calls him a kinsman, one of his own people, standing with him at the end of the letter.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the greetings are not filler: Sosipater is remembered because he stood with Paul, and I hold that standing with the gospel counts.
RelatedPeople: Paul; Timothy; Sosipater, Kinsman of Paul
